task: Customer received a duplicate order and asks what to do.
reference: We apologize that you received a duplicate order. We will review the order and payment details to confirm whether this was an error. If you were charged twice, we will arrange a refund, and we will provide instructions for returning the duplicate item if needed.
submission: We apologize that you received a duplicate order. We will review the order and payment details to confirm whether this was an error. If you were charged twice, we will arrange a refund and provide instructions for returning the duplicate item if needed.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply is complete and professional because it addresses payment, return instructions, and next steps clearly.

task: Customer complains about poor product quality.
reference: We are sorry to hear that the product did not meet your expectations. We take quality issues seriously and would like to help resolve this. Please share more details or images so we can investigate and offer a replacement or refund if eligible.
submission: The product may not be defective. Sometimes issues happen due to usage. Please send a photo so we can check the situation.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The response provides a next step but lacks empathy and includes an unnecessary assumption about customer usage.

task: Customer wants to delay the delivery date because they will not be home.
reference: We understand that you would like to delay the delivery date. We will check whether the shipment can still be rescheduled with the courier. If rescheduling is available, we will help update the delivery date. If not, we will suggest the best available delivery options.
submission: You should plan to be home when the order arrives.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply is unhelpful and judgmental, with no real solution.

task: Customer says a discount or coupon code they applied did not work and they were charged the full price.
reference: We are sorry to hear that your coupon code did not work as expected. We understand how frustrating that must be. We will apply the discount manually and refund the difference to your account within 2 to 3 business days. Please do not hesitate to contact us if you need any further assistance.
submission: Coupons expire. Yours was probably not valid anymore.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply assumes the coupon expired without checking, shows no apology or empathy, and offers no solution or next step, leaving the customer with nothing useful.

task: Customer requests an invoice for a previous order.
reference: We will be happy to help you get an invoice for your previous order. Please provide the order number or the email used for the purchase, and we will send the invoice to your registered email address as soon as possible.
submission: Please provide your order number, and we will send the invoice to your email.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply gives a correct next step but is brief and less helpful because it does not mention alternate identifying information or show much warmth.

task: Customer reports that an item is missing from their delivered order.
reference: We apologize for the missing item in your order. We understand how frustrating this must be. We will ship the missing item to you right away at no extra cost. Please expect it within 2 to 4 business days and let us know if there is anything else we can help you with.
submission: We will check on the missing item and get back to you shortly.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply promises a follow-up but gives no timeline, no shipping confirmation, and no empathy, leaving the customer without enough information to feel reassured.

task: Customer says their warranty claim was rejected and asks for clarification.
reference: We understand that you would like clarification about the rejected warranty claim. We will review the claim decision and explain the reason clearly. If any required documents or photos are missing, we will let you know how to resubmit the claim for another review.
submission: We understand that you would like clarification about the rejected warranty claim. We will review the claim decision and explain the reason clearly. If any documents or photos are missing, we will guide you on how to resubmit the claim for another review.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply is clear, supportive, and professional. It explains review, clarification, and possible resubmission steps.

task: Customer says the price changed after adding an item to the cart.
reference: We understand your concern about the price changing in your cart. Prices may change due to promotions ending, taxes, shipping fees, or regional pricing. We will review the item and cart details to confirm the reason and help you with the correct available price.
submission: Prices can change because of taxes, shipping fees, or promotions. Please send the item details and we will check the correct price.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply is accurate and useful but lacks empathy and reassurance.

task: Customer reports that their order was delivered to the wrong address.
reference: We sincerely apologize for the delivery issue. It appears the order was shipped to an incorrect address due to a system input error. We will contact the courier immediately to investigate and arrange a redelivery to the correct address as soon as possible.
submission: We already told you that delivery issues depend on courier systems and address accuracy. If your package went to the wrong place, it is not our responsibility. You should follow up with the courier because we cannot keep handling repeated mistakes like this.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The response is dismissive, unprofessional, and refuses responsibility or assistance while using a negative tone.

task: Customer did not receive an order confirmation email after payment.
reference: We are sorry that you did not receive your order confirmation email. We will verify the order using your payment details and resend the confirmation if the order was placed successfully. Please also check your spam or promotions folder in case the email was filtered there.
submission: If you did not get an email, maybe the order did not happen. That is not our issue.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply is dismissive and unhelpful, gives no resolution, and fails all professional support criteria.

task: Customer complains about slow customer service response.
reference: We sincerely apologize for the delay in responding to your request. Due to a high volume of inquiries, our response time has been longer than usual. We appreciate your patience and will assist you as quickly as possible.
submission: If you are waiting, that’s normal. We have too many customers and cannot reply fast. You should stop expecting instant replies.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The response lacks empathy, blames the customer indirectly, and uses an unprofessional tone.

task: Customer says loyalty points were not added after a purchase.
reference: We are sorry that your loyalty points were not added after your purchase. We will review your order and loyalty account details. If the purchase qualifies, we will add the missing points or explain clearly why the order was not eligible.
submission: We are sorry that your loyalty points were not added after your purchase. We will review your order and loyalty account details. If the purchase qualifies, we will add the missing points or explain clearly why it was not eligible.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply is empathetic, explains the review process, offers correction if eligible, and is professional.

task: Customer complains that their order was cancelled without reason.
reference: We understand your concern regarding the cancelled order. After reviewing your account, the order was cancelled due to a verification issue and could not be processed successfully. We apologize for the inconvenience and recommend trying again with a verified payment method.
submission: This happened because your account could not pass verification. You should have ensured your details were correct before placing the order. We are not responsible for such mistakes.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply is blaming the customer, lacks empathy, and uses an unprofessional tone despite giving a reason.

task: Customer wants to change the phone number linked to an order.
reference: We understand that you would like to update the phone number on your order. We will verify your order details and update the contact number if the order is still editable. If it has already been handed to the courier, we will help you request the update through the delivery provider.
submission: Please send us the correct phone number. We will check your order and update it if the order details can still be changed.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply is polite and useful, but it lacks empathy and does not explain the courier case if the order is already shipped.

task: Customer reports that their order was delivered to the wrong address.
reference: We sincerely apologize for the delivery issue. It appears the order was shipped to an incorrect address due to a system input error. We will contact the courier immediately to investigate and arrange a redelivery to the correct address as soon as possible.
submission: Your order was delivered to the wrong address. Please check with the courier yourself and confirm the address before contacting us again.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The response gives partial guidance but lacks empathy and does not provide a clear supportive resolution process.

task: Customer wants to update the delivery address after placing an order.
reference: We understand that you would like to update your delivery address. We will check whether the order has not yet shipped and update the address if possible. If the order has already shipped, we will help you contact the courier for the best available option.
submission: No. We do not fix customer mistakes after checkout.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply is rude, dismissive, and provides no assistance or professional explanation, so it fails all criteria.

task: Customer received a duplicate order and asks what to do.
reference: We apologize that you received a duplicate order. We will review the order and payment details to confirm whether this was an error. If you were charged twice, we will arrange a refund, and we will provide instructions for returning the duplicate item if needed.
submission: Keep the duplicate order or send it back yourself. This is not our responsibility.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply is dismissive, unhelpful, and unprofessional.

task: Customer requests an invoice for a previous order.
reference: We will be happy to help you get an invoice for your previous order. Please provide the order number or the email used for the purchase, and we will send the invoice to your registered email address as soon as possible.
submission: Send your order details so we can check the invoice.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply is partially helpful but vague and does not clearly state where or when the invoice will be sent.

task: Customer cannot log in due to account access restriction.
reference: We are sorry to hear that you are unable to access your account. For security reasons, access may be temporarily restricted after suspicious activity or multiple failed login attempts. Please try resetting your password or completing the account recovery process. If the issue continues, our support team will assist you further.
submission: We are sorry for the inconvenience. Your account access may be restricted due to security checks or multiple failed login attempts. Please try resetting your password or using the account recovery option.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: Clear, polite, and complete response that explains the restriction and provides a direct recovery step.

task: Customer did not receive an order confirmation email after payment.
reference: We are sorry that you did not receive your order confirmation email. We will verify the order using your payment details and resend the confirmation if the order was placed successfully. Please also check your spam or promotions folder in case the email was filtered there.
submission: We can verify your order and resend the confirmation email if the payment was completed. Please check your spam folder as well.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply gives correct information and useful steps, but it is less empathetic and less reassuring than an excellent response.
